blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Characterising individual cells is fundamental to computational pathology, as cellular morphology informs tasks such as tumour grading, mitotic assessment and immune profiling. However, most pathology foundation models are trained on tissue patches and capture cellular features only implicitly, while existing cell-level models are either restricted to specific cell populations or rely on computationally expensive architectures with hundreds of millions of parameters. Applying ViTs directly to small cellular crops also presents an architectural challenge: upsampling increases computational cost without adding morphological information and may introduce interpolation artefacts. To address these limitations, we introduce C-LiTE, a lightweight foundation model for cellular representation learning in H&E-stained histopathology, with only 22 million parameters. C-LiTE employs a native-resolution tokenisation strategy tailored to cellular inputs, processing 64 x 64 px cell-centred crops using a 4 x 4 patch embedding to produce a 16 x 16 token grid without image upsampling. To transfer visual knowledge from large-scale pre-training, we adapt the patch embedding weights of a pre-trained ViT-5-S using a pseudoinverse-based transformation, enabling weight initialisation at the finer patch resolution. We further assemble a pre-training dataset of 60 million cell-centred crops from TCGA, balanced across 19 cancer types and 16 tissue types. To our knowledge, this represents the largest public dataset for self-supervised pre-training on H&E images at the cellular level. We evaluate C-LiTE on seven public datasets spanning mitotic figure recognition, nucleus and cell-type classification, and immune cell phenotyping. Under frozen-feature evaluation, C-LiTE achieves a mean macro-F1 of 0.670, approaching CytoFormer (0.682) with approximately 30x fewer parameters.
blocks.zh: 对单个细胞进行定性是计算病理学的根本,因为细胞形态学为肿瘤分级,线粒体评估和免疫特征分析等任务提供了信息. 然而,大多数病理基础模型只接受组织补丁和捕捉细胞特征的培训,而现有的细胞级模型要么局限于特定的细胞群,要么依赖于具有数亿参数的计算昂贵的架构. 应用 直接对小型蜂窝作物的维T也带来了建筑挑战:在不增加形态信息的情况下,取样会增加计算成本,并可能引入插图工艺。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了C-LiTE,一种在H&E有染组织病理学中进行细胞表达学习的轻量级基础模型,只有2200万个参数. C-LiTE采用了适合蜂窝输入的本土分辨率标识策略,使用4×4的补丁嵌入处理64×64 px细胞中心作物,生成16×16的代币网格,不进行图像检测. 为了从大规模预训中传递视觉知识,我们利用伪反向变换,调整了预训VIT-5-S的补丁嵌入权重,使得重量在更细的补丁分辨率上能够初始化. 我们还从TCGA收集了6 000万个以细胞为中心的作物的培训前数据集,在19种癌症类型和16种组织类型之间进行了平衡。 据我们所知,这是在细胞一级自我监督的H&E图像预培训的最大公共数据集。 我们评价C-LiTE的七个公共数据集, 包括线粒体的识别, 核细胞和细胞类型的分类, 以及免疫细胞的麻黄。 在冷冻度评价下,C-LiTE实现0.670的中间宏F1,接近CytoFormer(0.682),参数减少约30x.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining forms the basis of histopathological diagnosis, providing information about tissue architecture and cellular composition. A single H&E-stained WSI contains hundreds of thousands of nuclei belonging to different cell types. Analysis of these WSIs involves identifying the cell types (inferred from nuclei) present, quantifying their relative abundance, and characterising their spatial organisation ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . These cellular features, such as immune infiltration, provide important information for diagnostic, prognostic, and treatment decisions ( Virchow, 1863 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) in clinical practice. However, extracting such information accurately at scale remains challenging. In current computational workflows, this often requires manual annotation of cells or nuclei by pathologists, followed by the development of supervised models specific to individual datasets ( Hörst et al., 2023 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Nasir et al., 2023 ) . Such models typically require fine-tuning or retraining when applied to new datasets, limiting their generalisability and increasing the reliance on task-specific and dataset-specific annotations.
blocks.zh: Haematoxylin和eosin(H&E)染色构成组织病理学诊断的基础,提供组织结构和细胞组成方面的信息. 一个单一的H&E染色的WSI包含数十万个属于不同细胞类型的核. 对这些WSI的分析涉及确定存在的细胞类型(从核糖体中推导出),量化其相对丰度,并确定其空间组织特征(姚等,2026年)。 这些细胞特征,如免疫渗透,为诊断、预测和治疗决定提供了重要信息(Virchow,第1段)。 1863;张等,2025)临床实践. 然而,准确获取此类信息的规模仍然具有挑战性。 在当前计算工作流程中,这往往需要由病理学家对细胞或核进行人工注释,然后开发单个数据集特有的被监督模型(Hörst等,2023;Lv等,2026;Nasir等,2023.). 这种模型通常需要在适用于新数据集时进行微调或再培训,限制其可通用性并增加对特定任务和数据集说明的依赖。

blocks.en:
Recent advances in self-supervised foundation models offer a promising alternative, enabling the learning of transferable features from large-scale histopathology data that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. Models such as UNI ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , Virchow2 ( Zimmermann et al., 2024 ) , CONCH ( Lu et al., 2023 ) , CTransPath ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , Phikon ( Filiot et al., 2024 ) , Prov-GigaPath ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , and TITAN ( Ding et al., 2025 ) have established a powerful paradigm for learning generalisable features from WSIs. These models are trained on either image patches containing hundreds of cells or whole-slide images (WSIs) containing thousands of cells, allowing them to capture a combination of cellular morphology, stromal composition, tissue architecture, and spatial context.
However, these models are primarily developed for whole-slide or patch-level feature extraction and cannot adequately capture the fine-grained morphological features required to distinguish individual cell types. Moreover, the substantial computational and memory requirements of these models present a significant challenge for cell-level analysis. Applying these models independently to thousands of nuclei within a single WSI would be computationally expensive and difficult to scale, limiting their practical utility for high-throughput cellular characterisation.

Prov-Gigapath (徐等, 2024), TITAN (Ding等, 2025)建立了从WSIs学习通俗特征的强大范式. 这些模型要么是包含上百个细胞的图像补丁,要么是包含上千个细胞的全滑行图像(WSI),使其能捕捉细胞形态,分层组成,组织架构,以及空间上下文的组合.
然而,这些模型主要是为全滑或补丁级特征提取而开发的,无法充分捕捉出区分单个细胞类型所需的细纹形态特征. 此外,这些模型的大量计算和内存要求对细胞层面的分析构成重大挑战。 将这些模型独立应用到单个WSI的上千个核子上,在计算上会很昂贵,难以被分级,限制了它们对于高通量蜂窝特性化的实际用途.

blocks.en:
Recognising these limitations, recent work has shifted towards cell-centric feature learning in histopathology ( Chadoutaud et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . By focusing explicitly on individual cells, these approaches aim to learn features that better capture intrinsic cellular morphology and state. However, this shift towards cell-level modelling does not fully resolve the computational challenge. For example, CytoFormer ( Yao et al., 2026 ) , a recent cell-centric foundation model, comprises approximately 681 million parameters, retaining substantial computational and memory requirements comparable to those of existing pathology foundation models. This presents practical challenges for inference and limits the efficiency of cell-centric foundation models in large-scale cellular analysis. These limitations highlight the need for an efficient and lightweight foundation model for H&E-stained cells. Such a model should learn rich and generalisable cellular representations while reducing computational requirements. This need is further reinforced by growing concerns about the computational and environmental costs of modern AI. The Green AI framework advocates treating computational efficiency as an objective alongside predictive performance, highlighting the financial and environmental costs of deep learning and the contribution of inference to overall AI deployment costs ( Schwartz et al., 2020 ; Strubell et al., 2019 ; Luccioni et al., 2024 ) . To address this need, we introduce C-LiTE , a compact self-supervised model for generalisable cellular feature learning at single-cell resolution. C-LiTE is pre-trained on approximately 60M cell-centric image crops spanning 19 cancer types, 16 tissue types, and multiple staining protocols. This diverse training corpus captures a broad spectrum of cellular morphologies. We adapt the ViT-5 backbone within a teacher–student self-supervised framework using DINO and iBOT objectives. The resulting model learns transferable cellular representations that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks while preserving continuous morphological variation without being constrained by predefined cell categories. C-LiTE supports a diverse range of applications, including label-free cellular phenotyping, cell classification, mitosis classification, and morphology-based feature extraction. Across extensive evaluations, it achieves competitive performance against substantially larger cell-centric foundation models and tile-level pathology foundation models evaluated on cell crops. These results demonstrate the ability of C-LiTE to deliver high-quality cellular representations at substantially lower computational cost. The overall architecture of the proposed C-LiTE framework is presented in Fig. 1 .
The main contributions of our work are as follows: 1. We develop C-LiTE , comprising: (a) a compact 22M-parameter model for cellular feature learning, adapting the ViT-5 backbone to process 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell crops at native resolution within a self-supervised teacher–student framework. (b) a large and diverse cell-centric pre-training corpus comprising over 60M cell-centric image crops , spanning 19 cancer types and 16 tissue types , and covering diverse tissue contexts. (c) the Pseudoinverse-Initialised Patch Embedding formulation (PI-PatchEmbed) , which transfers pre-trained ViT-5-S weights from 16 × 16 16\times 16 to 4 × 4 4\times 4 patch projections using a Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse-based spatial transfer operator. 2. We demonstrate that C-LiTE learns transferable cellular representations that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks, achieving performance comparable to CytoFormer ( Yao et al., 2026 ) despite having approximately 30 × \times fewer parameters . 3. We demonstrate the versatility of C-LiTE across diverse tasks, including immune cell phenotyping, cell-type classification, pan-cancer nucleus classification, hierarchical cell classification, and mitosis classification. 4. We provide open access to the C-LiTE models, pre-training dataset, source code, and training configurations to facilitate reproducibility and encourage the research community to build upon our work.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Pathology Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 病理学基础模型

blocks.en: The emergence of pathology foundation models has reshaped computational pathology, with self-supervised pre-training becoming a widely adopted approach for learning transferable features from large-scale histopathology data ( Hua et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Early transformer-based methods, such as CTransPath ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , demonstrated that features learned from a large collection of unlabelled tissue patches could transfer effectively across a range of downstream tasks. HIPT (Hierarchical Image Pyramid Transformer) ( Chen et al., 2022 ) subsequently extended this paradigm through hierarchical pre-training at multiple magnification levels, enabling the modelling of information across cellular and tissue scales.
blocks.zh: 病理学基础模型的出现使计算病理学被重塑了,自我监督的预训成为从大规模组织病理学数据中学习可转移特征的一种被广泛采纳的方法(Hua等,2024;Zhong等,2026). CTransPath(Wang等,2022年)等基于变压器的早期方法表明,从大量收集的无标签组织补丁中吸取的特征可以有效跨越一系列下游任务. HIPT (Hierartical Image Pyramid Transformer)(Chen等,2022年)之后通过分级前训练在多放大水平上扩展了这一范式,使得信息可以跨细胞和组织尺度建模.

blocks.en: Subsequent work has increasingly focused on scaling training data and model capacity, together with advances in pre-training strategies. For example, UNI ( Chen et al., 2024b ) adapted the DINOv2 framework and pre-trained a ViT-Large model on more than 100M image patches extracted from over 100K diagnostic slides spanning 20 tissue types. Building on this approach, UNI2 employs a ViT-Giant architecture and was trained on approximately 200M image tiles sampled from more than 350K diverse H&E and IHC-stained slides.
blocks.zh: 随后的工作越来越侧重于扩大培训数据和模型能力,以及培训前战略的进展。 例如,UNI(Chen等,2024年b)调整了DINOv2框架,并在100多张诊断幻灯片中提取出超过20个组织类型的100M多张图像补丁上预先训练了ViT-Large模型。 在这种方法的基础上,UNI2采用了ViT-Giant架构,并接受了关于从350K多张不同的H&E和有IHC色彩的幻灯片中取样的约200M相片的培训。

blocks.en: Virchow and Virchow2 ( Zimmermann et al., 2024 ) further increased both model and dataset scale, employing a ViT-Huge architecture and training on approximately 3.1M WSIs. Their training framework uses a similar self-supervised teacher–student paradigm with global and local crops, together with extended-context translation (ECT) augmentation to preserve cellular morphology. In addition, the standard KoLeo regulariser was replaced with a kernel density estimation (KDE)-based regulariser to improve the learned feature distribution. Phikon further increased the scale and diversity of training data, using approximately 460M pathology tiles spanning more than 30 cancer sites. It also adopts a DINOv2-based self-supervised framework ( Filiot et al., 2024 ) . Alongside these image-based approaches, alternative pre-training paradigms have emerged that extend beyond image-only representation learning. CONCH (CONtrastive learning from Captions for Histopathology) ( Lu et al., 2023 ) introduced contrastive vision–language learning using diverse histopathology images and biomedical text, including more than 1.17M image–caption pairs within a task-agnostic pre-training framework. Prov-GigaPath ( Xu et al., 2024 ) shifted the focus towards slide-level representation learning for WSIs understanding. It was pre-trained on 1.3B 256 × 256 256\times 256 px image tiles extracted from 171K WSIs spanning 31 tissue types. A key component of its training strategy was the incorporation of an adapted LongNet architecture to enable efficient modelling of whole-slide sequences. Extending the development of pathology foundation models towards multimodal learning, TITAN ( Ding et al., 2025 ) was trained on 335K WSIs using self-supervised learning and vision–language alignment. Collectively, these studies have established tissue patches and WSIs as the predominant training units for pathology foundation models, while demonstrating the value of increasing data scale, model capacity, and pre-training diversity for learning generalisable pathology features ( Rajendran et al., 2027 ) .
blocks.zh: 维肖和维肖2 (Zimmermann等,2024年)进一步增加了模型和数据集尺度,采用了ViT-Huge架构,并进行了大约3.1M WSIs的培训. 他们的训练框架采用了类似的自我监督的教师模式—— 具有全球和当地作物的学生模式,以及扩展文本翻译(ECT)增强来保存细胞形态。 此外,标准Koleo regulariser被取而代之的是基于内核密度估计(KDE)的regulariser来改进所学到的特性分布. Phikon进一步提高了培训数据的规模和多样性,使用了覆盖了30多个癌症地点的约460M个病理瓷砖. 它还采用了基于DINOv2的自我监督框架(Filiot等人,2024年)。 除了这些以形象为基础的方法之外,还出现了其他的培训前范式,这些范式超越了仅以形象为基础的代表性学习。 CONCH(从病理学标题学习) (Lu等, 2023年) 引入了对比视觉-语言学习,使用不同的病理学图像和生物医学文本,包括超过1.17M的图像-在任务不可知的预训练框架内进行。 Prov-Gigapath(徐等,2024年-)将重点转向滑行层代表学习,以达到WSI的理解. 它在1.3B 256 × 256\times 256px影像瓦片上被预训,取自171K WSI,跨越了31个组织类型. 其培训战略的一个关键组成部分是纳入经过改造的LongNet架构,以便能够有效模拟整个滑坡序列。 将病理学基础模型的发展扩展到多模式学习,TITAN(Ding等人,2025年)接受了关于335K类西语课程的培训,采用自我监督的学习和视觉-语言相配合。 这些研究共同建立了组织补丁和WSI,作为病理基础模型的主要培训单位,同时展示了增加数据规模、模型能力和培训前多样性对学习通俗病理特征的价值(Rajendran等,2027年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Supervised Cell Classification Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 监督细胞分类模型

blocks.en: At the cellular level, computational pathology has traditionally relied on supervised methods for cell detection, segmentation, and classification. Approaches such as HoVer-Net ( Graham et al., 2019 ) , StarDist ( Schmidt et al., 2018 ) , and CellViT ( Hörst et al., 2023 ) have achieved strong performance through training on densely annotated datasets with predefined cell taxonomies. However, these methods are typically designed for specific downstream tasks, with their learned representations closely tied to the annotations and cell categories available during training. Developing such models often requires extensive manual annotation by experts, which limits scalability and can restrict generalisability across datasets. These limitations have motivated a shift towards learning transferable cellular features directly from large-scale, unlabelled histopathology data.
blocks.zh: 在细胞一级,计算病理学传统上依赖受监督的细胞检测、分化和分类方法。 HoVer-Net(Graham等,2019年),StarDist(Smidt等,2018年),以及CellViT等方法. (Hörst等人,2023年)通过使用预定义的细胞分类法,对注释繁多的数据集进行培训,取得了强效. 然而,这些方法一般是为具体的下游任务而设计的,其学到的表述与说明和在培训期间的细胞类别密切相关。 开发这种模型往往需要专家进行广泛的人工说明,这限制了可扩展性,并可能限制各种数据集的通用性。 这些限制促使人们从大规模无标签的组织病理学数据直接转向学习可转移的细胞特征。

blocks.en: 2.3 Pathology Cell Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 病理学细胞基础模型

blocks.en: Building on this motivation, recent foundation models have explored self-supervised learning to capture generalisable features across diverse cellular morphologies and tissue contexts. VOLTA ( Nakhli et al., 2024 ) introduced environment-aware contrastive learning to jointly model individual cells and their surrounding micro-environment. It was trained on approximately 700K cells from 4 cancer types and demonstrated that meaningful cellular phenotypes can be learnt without manual annotation. DinoBloom ( Koch et al., 2024 ) further extended self-supervised pre-training to approximately 380K white blood cells (WBCs) from blood and bone marrow tissue across 13 publicly available datasets, producing features that transfer across a range of haematological tasks. More recently, LEMON ( Chadoutaud et al., 2026 ) adopted a MoCo v3-based self-supervised framework and was trained on approximately 10M individual nuclei from 10 tissue types. Using 40 × 40 40\times 40 px nuclear crops, LEMON demonstrated that nuclear morphology contains rich biological information that can be captured without explicit cell-type labels. Similarly, CytoFormer ( Yao et al., 2026 ) further advanced cell-centric foundation modelling in histopathology by leveraging paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics data to derive molecularly informed cell-type supervision across 16 tissue types. Together, these studies demonstrate the feasibility of learning transferable cellular representations at scale, but differ substantially in their cellular coverage, supervision, and model design.
blocks.zh: 基于这一动机,最近的基础模型探索了自我监督的学习,以掌握不同细胞形态和组织背景的可通用特征。 VOLTA(Nakhli等,2024年)引入了环境认知对比性学习,以联合模拟单个细胞及其周围的微观环境. 它对来自4个癌症类型的约700K细胞进行了培训,并证明无需人工注释即可学习有意义的细胞酚类。 DinoBloom(Koch等,2024年)将自我监督的预训范围进一步扩展到了来自血液和骨髓组织的约380K白血球(WBC),跨越了13个公开的数据集,产生了跨越一系列出血任务转移的特征. 最近,LEMON(Chadoutaud等,2026年)采用了基于MoCo v3的自我监督框架,并接受了来自10个组织类型的大约10M个个体核素的培训。 LEMON使用40×40 40\times 40 px核作物,证明了核形态包含丰富的生物信息,可以在没有明确细胞型标签的情况下被捕获. 同样地,CytoFormer(Yao等,2026年)通过利用配对H&E和空间转录相学数据,在组织病理学中进一步推进以细胞为中心的基础建模,以获得16个组织类型的分子知情细胞类型监督. 这些研究共同显示,学习可转移的手机表示方式具有规模的可行性,但在手机的覆盖、监督和模型设计方面差别很大。

blocks.en: Existing supervised approaches remain focused on specific cellular datasets, while self-supervised cell foundation models require substantially larger architectures and, in some cases, additional molecular supervision. These approaches also face challenges in preserving fine-grained cellular information. For example, resizing cell crops from 56 × 56 56\times 56 μ \mu m to 224 × 224 224\times 224 μ \mu m changes the native spatial scale of the input and may lead to the loss of fine morphological detail. In contrast, LEMON operates on smaller 40 × 40 40\times 40 crops with an 8 × 8 8\times 8 patch size, producing only 25 patch tokens. This is substantially fewer than the 256 patch tokens produced by a standard DINOv2 configuration using a 224 × 224 224\times 224 px input with a 14 × 14 14\times 14 patch size. The limited number of patch tokens may therefore restrict the spatial information available to the transformer for modelling fine-grained cellular morphology.
blocks.zh: 现有的监督方法仍然侧重于具体的细胞数据集,而自我监督的细胞基模型则需要大得多的结构,在某些情况下还需要额外的分子监督. 这些方法在保存精细细胞信息方面也面临挑战。 例如将细胞收成由56×56 56\times 56 μ μ μ m调整为224×224\times 224 μ μ μ m改变输入的原生空间尺度,并可能导致细小形态细节的丢失. 相形之下,LEMON运行在较小的40×40 40\times的40个农作物上,有8×8 8\times 8个补丁大小,只产生25个补丁符号. 这大大少于由标准DINOv2配置所生产的256个补丁符号,使用224×224\times 224px输入,并有14×1414\times 14补丁大小. 因此,补丁令牌数量有限,可能限制变压器可用于建模细纹细胞形态的空间信息.

What patch size is most appropriate for self-supervised learning at cellular resolution? 3. More broadly, can a compact model trained directly on a large and diverse collection of histopathological cells learn transferable feature representations of cellular morphology without relying on increasingly large architectures or explicit molecular supervision?

blocks.en: Building on these questions, C-LiTE extends cell-centric foundation modelling to a substantially larger and more diverse histopathology corpus while maintaining a compact architecture.
blocks.zh: 在这些问题的基础上,C-LiTE将以细胞为中心的基础建模扩展至一个大得多、更多样化的病理学体,同时维持一个紧凑的结构。

blocks.en: 3 Pre-training Data
blocks.zh: 3 培训前数据

blocks.en: A key contribution of C-LiTE is the construction of, to the best of our knowledge, one of the largest and most diverse cell-centric histopathology pre-training corpora reported to date. The corpus comprises approximately 60M cell-centred image crops derived from TCGA WSIs across 19 cancer types. This heterogeneous collection provides a large-scale pre-training resource designed to capture diverse cellular morphologies and support the learning of robust and transferable cellular representations. The resulting model is subsequently evaluated across a diverse set of downstream tasks, including immune cell phenotyping, nucleus classification, cell-type classification, and mitosis classification.
blocks.zh: C-LiTE的一项关键贡献是,根据我们所知,迄今为止报告建造了最大和最多样化的细胞中心组织病理学前科。 该病历包括大约60M个以细胞为中心的图像作物,这些作物来自TCGA WSI,覆盖了19个癌症类型。 这种多样化的收集提供了大规模的培训前资源,旨在捕捉不同的细胞形态,并支持学习强健可转移的细胞表现。 由此产生的模型随后在一系列不同的下游任务中进行评估,包括免疫细胞的分泌、核细胞分类、细胞类型分类和线粒体分泌。

blocks.en: 3.1 TCGA Cell Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 TCGA 单元格数据集

blocks.en: The primary source of pre-training data in this study is The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). The dataset covers 19 cancer types, including breast carcinoma (BRCA), lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC), ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma (OV), colon adenocarcinoma (COAD), rectal adenocarcinoma (READ), cervical squamous cell carcinoma and endocervical adenocarcinoma (CESC), kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC), kidney renal papillary cell carcinoma (KIRP), pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD), liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC), prostate adenocarcinoma (PRAD), uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma (UCEC), uterine carcinosarcoma (UCS), thyroid carcinoma (THCA), stomach adenocarcinoma (STAD), head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSC), bladder urothelial carcinoma (BLCA), and adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC). These 19 cancer types represent 16 distinct tissue types. Specifically, lung (LUAD and LUSC), kidney (KIRC and KIRP), and uterus (UCEC and UCS) each contribute two cancer-type cohorts originating from the same tissue, whereas the remaining 13 cancer types each correspond to a distinct tissue type. Throughout the paper, we use cancer type to refer to the 19 cohort-level categories and tissue type to refer to the 16 distinct tissues represented in the pre-training corpus.
blocks.zh: 本研究培训前数据的主要来源是癌症基因组图集。 该数据集涵盖19种癌症类型,包括:乳腺癌(BRCA)、肺腺癌(LUAD)、肺分泌细胞癌(LUSC)、卵巢癌(OV)、肠腺癌(COAD)、肾腺癌(READ)、宫颈癌(CESC)、宫颈癌(CESC)、肾肾清细胞癌(KIRC)、肾肾肾上腺癌(KIRP)、肾肾肾上腺癌(KIRP)、肝细胞癌(KIRP)、胰腺癌(PAD)、肝肝细胞癌(LIHC)、前列腺癌(PRAD)、子宫癌(CUEC)、子宫癌(UCC)、子宫癌(CUCS)、甲状腺癌(THCA)、胃癌(STCAD)、头部和颈颈癌(CONCI)、癌)。 这19种癌症代表了16种不同的组织类型. 具体来说,肺(LUAD和LUSC)、肾(KIRC和KIRP)和子宫(UCEC和UCS)各造成来自同一组织的两种癌症类型,而其余13种癌症类型则分别对应一种不同的组织类型。 整篇论文中,我们使用癌症类型来指代19个组群级类别和组织类型来指代训练前的16个不同的组织.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Data Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 国家 数据生成

blocks.en: Each WSI was processed using HoVer-Net ( Graham et al., 2019 ) to obtain instance-level nuclear segmentations at a resolution of 0.50 0.50 microns per pixel (mpp), corresponding to approximately 20 × 20\times magnification. Inference was performed on a high-performance computing (HPC) cluster equipped with NVIDIA A100 GPUs . For each detected nucleus, a fixed-size 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell-centric crop was extracted, centred on the predicted nuclear centroid. Because these detections were used directly to define crop locations without manual verification, the resulting corpus may contain detection noise arising from missed nuclei, false-positive detections, or inaccurate centroid estimates. Given the scale of the corpus ( ∼ \sim 60M crops), we did not explicitly quantify or correct for this noise, instead relying on the robustness of the self-supervised pre-training objective to occasional imperfect or miscentred crops. We have presented the data generation process in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 每个WSI都用HoVer-Net(Graham等,2019年)进行处理,以每像素(mpp)0.50微米的分辨率获得实例级核分,相当于约20×20相放大. 在配备了NVIDIA A100 GPU的高性能计算(HPC)集群上进行了推论. 对于被检测出的每一颗核糖体,都提取出以预测的核心机器人为核心的固定尺寸的64×64\times 64px细胞中心作物. 由于这些探测是在未经人工核实的情况下直接用来界定作物位置的,因此由此产生的探测器可能含有因核子缺失、假阳性探测或中间行星估计不准确而产生的探测噪音。 鉴于这种作物的规模(\\sim 60M作物),我们没有明确量化或纠正这种噪音,而是依赖自我监督的预先训练目标是否有力,偶尔不完善或以错误为中心的作物。 我们在图2中介绍了数据生成过程。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: The overall framework for C-LiTE is shown in Fig. 1 , and the downstream tasks are shown in Fig. 2 . Here, pre-training data are first generated using HoVer-Net ( Graham et al., 2019 ) and then subsampled to ensure balanced representation across cancer types.
blocks.zh: C-LiTE的整体框架如图1所示,下游任务如图2所示. 在此,培训前数据首先使用HoVer-Net(Graham等,2019年)生成,然后进行分样取出,以确保癌症类型中的均衡代表性.

blocks.en: The approach has three key components. First, we adapt Pseudoinverse-Initialised Patch Embedding (PI-PatchEmbed) to transfer the pre-trained 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch projection of ViT-5-S to a 4 × 4 4\times 4 projection for cell-scale images. This allows 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell crops to use pre-trained ViT-5 weights directly, without resizing. Second, we develop two pathology-specific distilled models based on UNI2 and Virchow2. We apply knowledge distillation to a subset of our data, using 1M images from each cancer type and 19M images in total. These distilled models provide pathology-specific weights for initialising the subsequent self-supervised learning. Third, we pre-train the adapted encoder using a DINOv2-style self-supervised learning framework. We modify the standard DINOv2 training recipe by using only global crops. We do not use local crops because each input already corresponds to a complete cell-centred image at the target spatial scale.
blocks.zh: 这种办法有三个关键组成部分。 首先,我们调整Pseudoinvers-Initioned Patch Embedding(PI-Patch-Embed),将经过预训的16×16 16\tims 16补丁投影ViT-5-S转移到4×4 4\tims 4的细胞尺度图像投影. 这使得64×64 64\times 64 px细胞作物可以直接使用预先训练的ViT-5重量,而无需调整尺寸. 第二,我们基于UNI2和Virchow2开发出两个针对病理学的蒸馏模型. 我们把知识分馏应用到我们的数据子集中, 使用来自每一种癌症的1M图像和总共19M图像。 这些蒸馏模型为初始化后自导自演的学习提供了病理学特有的分量. 第三,我们使用DINov2风格的自我监督学习框架,对经过改造的编码器进行预训. 我们只使用全球作物来修改标准的DINOv2训练食谱. 我们不使用本地作物,因为每一种输入都已经与目标空间尺度的完整的以细胞为中心的图像相对应.

blocks.en: 4.1 Pseudoinverse-Initialised Patch Embedding (PI-PatchEmbed)
blocks.zh: 4.1 Pseudoinvers-Initialized 补丁嵌入(PI-Patch-Embed)

blocks.en: C-LiTE uses ViT-5-S ( Wang et al., 2026 ) as its ViT backbone. We selected ViT-5-S over standard ViT-S because its architectural refinements, including RMSNorm, QK-Norm, LayerScale, and 2-dimensional rotary positional embeddings (2D RoPE), improve performance at small parameter counts compared with a standard ViT-S of comparable size ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . These properties are well suited to the limited spatial extent of the cell crops. We retain these components and modify only the input patch projection. The original ViT-5-S uses a 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch projection for 224 × 224 224\times 224 px inputs, yielding a 14 × 14 14\times 14 spatial token grid. For 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell crops, we replace this with a 4 × 4 4\times 4 projection.

blocks.en: 4.2 Pathology Foundation model Distillation to ViT-5-S
blocks.zh: 4.2 病理学基础模型Distillation to ViT-5-S

blocks.en: For initialising the model with pathology-specific pre-trained weights, we applied knowledge distillation from Virchow2 ( Zimmermann et al., 2024 ) and UNI2 ( Chen et al., 2024b ) on a subset of our training data and developed a ViT-5-S model. The subset was built by randomly sampling 1M cell crops from each TCGA tissue type, giving a cohort of 19M cell crops. Knowledge distillation was then applied by keeping the pre-trained teacher (Virchow2 or UNI2) frozen and making the student (ViT-5-S with a 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch projection) trainable. At this stage, no labels are used, and the student is trained purely to reproduce the teacher’s embedding of each image. For this step, each 64 × 64 64\times 64 px crop is resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 px and augmented with random horizontal and vertical flips and random rotations of up to 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} . The teacher and student receive an identical augmented view of each image. Since the student embedding ( d s = 384 d_{s}=384 ) and the teacher embedding ( d t = 1536 d_{t}=1536 for UNI2 and d t = 1280 d_{t}=1280 for Virchow2) differ in dimensionality, a linear projection W ∈ ℝ d t × d s W\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{t}\times d_{s}} is attached to the student output to match the teacher’s embedding dimension. It is trained jointly with the student and discarded after distillation. This projection is required for loss estimation. For loss calculation, we use mean squared error (MSE) and cosine distance jointly. Thus, this training produces two distilled ViT-5-S models, one using UNI2 and the other using Virchow2 as the teacher. Fig. 4 demonstrates the distillation process used to transfer weights from the pre-trained UNI2 and Virchow2 models to the lightweight ViT-5-S architecture. The distillation training configurations are provided in Table A.10 .

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: To evaluate C-LiTE, we compare it with state-of-the-art foundation models. All models were evaluated on the benchmark datasets described below under a common linear-probing protocol and using similar evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了评价C-LiTE,我们把它和最先进的基础模型进行比较. 根据共同的线性测试协议并利用类似的评估指标,对所有模型进行了以下基准数据集的评价。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All models were evaluated in a frozen backbone setting, with the pre-trained encoder kept fixed and a lightweight classifier trained on the resulting feature embeddings. For consistency across models, we used the class token embedding from the final transformer layer as the input representation for downstream evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有模型均在被冷冻的骨干设置中进行评估,预训编码器被固定,而轻量级分类器则在由此而来的特点嵌入上接受了培训. 为了各模型的一致性,我们使用从最后变压器层嵌入的类符号作为下游评价的输入代表.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Baselines

The performance was compared against nine baseline models spanning three pre-training categories, summarised in Table 1 : natural-image models , pre-trained on natural images without any pathology-specific data; patch-level pathology foundation models , pre-trained on tissue patches containing multiple cells; and cell-level foundation models , pre-trained directly on individual cells. Natural-image models (DINOv2) provide a lower bound: pre-trained without any pathology exposure, they establish how much transfer is achievable from generic visual features alone.
blocks.zh: 将表现与表1概述的9个涵盖三个培训前类别的基线模型进行比较:自然成像模型、在自然图像上进行预先训练而没有任何病理特定数据;补丁级病理基础模型、在含有多细胞的组织补丁上进行预先训练;以及细胞级基础模型,直接在单个细胞上进行预先训练。 自然成像模型(DINOv2)提供了一个下限:在没有任何病理暴露的情况下进行预训,它们确定仅从一般视觉特征上就可以实现多少转移.

blocks.en: Patch-level pathology foundation models (Phikon, Virchow2, UNI2) are pre-trained on tissue patches containing hundreds of cells and therefore encode cellular morphology jointly with tissue architecture and stromal context; this additional context can aid tasks where surrounding tissue is diagnostic, but it also couples the representation to the micro-environment, as discussed in Section 6 . Cell-level foundation models (DinoBloom, LEMON, CytoFormer) are pre-trained directly on cell crops and so isolate cellular morphology from tissue context. Among these, CytoFormer additionally incorporates molecular supervision from spatial transcriptomics, which is expected to sharpen decision boundaries for molecularly defined subtypes (e.g. CD4/CD8/CD20 populations) at the cost of a substantially larger architecture. This spans a parameter range of 22M–681M, allowing direct comparison from small models i.e., 22M parameters to computationally large parametric models i.e., 681M parameters. This comparison isolates the effect of pre-training domain from that of model scale. All baseline weights were obtained from their respective public releases and were trained using the linear classification head described in subsubsection 5.1.4 .
blocks.zh: 补丁级病理基础模型(Phikon, Virchow2, UNI2)在含有上百个细胞的组织补丁上进行预训,因此结合组织架构和分层环境将细胞形态编码;这种额外的环境可以帮助周围组织进行诊断的任务,但正如第6节所讨论,它也与微观环境的表述相配。 细胞层次的基础模型(DinoBloom,LEMON,CytoFormer)在细胞作物上被预先训练,因此将细胞形态与组织背景隔离. 其中CytoFormer还从空间转录相学中加入了分子监督,预计这将会以一个大得多的建筑为代价,对分子定义的子类型(如CD4/CD8/CD20人口)作出更清晰的决定界限. 这跨越了22M–681M的参数范围,可以直接从小模型,即22M参数到计算出大参数模型,即681M参数. 这种比较将培训前域与模型规模域的效果隔离开来. 所有基准权重均取自各自的公开发布,并使用分节5.1.4所描述的线性分类头来培训。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Benchmark Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 基准数据集

blocks.en: To evaluate the quality and generalisability of the learned representations, we benchmark C-LiTE across 7 publicly available datasets covering a diverse range of downstream tasks. These benchmarks include immune cell phenotyping, fine-grained cell classification, pan-cancer nucleus classification, mitosis classification, and hierarchical nucleus subtyping. Collectively, they span diverse organs, staining protocols, imaging resolutions, annotation strategies, and cellular taxonomies, providing a comprehensive assessment of representation transfer across biological and imaging domains. Fig. 2 shows the process of dataset curation and downstream tasks performed via C-LiTE.
blocks.zh: 为了评估所学到的表述的质量和普遍性,我们把C-LiTE作为基准,涵盖7个可公开获得的数据集,涵盖各种下游任务。 这些基准包括免疫细胞的麻黄,细毛细胞分级,泛癌核分级,线粒体分级,分级核分型等. 它们共同跨越不同的器官、污渍协议、成像分辨率、注释策略和细胞分类,对生物和成像领域的代表转移进行了全面评估。 图2显示了通过C-LiTE完成的数据集整理过程和下游任务.

blocks.en: The mitosis classification task involves classifying mitotic figures as normal or atypical. For this, we have employed the dataset from the MIDOG 2025 challenge ( Aubreville et al., 2026 ) . These datasets include the official MIDOG25 training data, along with Ami-Br ( Bertram et al., 2025 ) , OMG-Octo ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , AtNorm-Br ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ) and TCGA Subtyping ( Jahanifar, 2025 ) . Collectively, these datasets encompass multiple tissue types, institutions, and imaging domains, providing a challenging benchmark for mitosis recognition and domain generalisation ( Nasir et al., 2026 ) . The corresponding dataset characteristics are summarised in Table A.2 .
blocks.zh: 线粒体分级任务涉及将线粒体数字分类为正常或非典型. 为此,我们采用了MIDOG 2025挑战的数据集(Aubreville等人,2026年)。 这些数据集包括官方的MIDOG25培训数据,以及Ami-Br(Bertram等,2025年),OMG-Octo(沈等,2025年),AtNorm-Br(Banerje等,2025年)和TCGASubtyping(Jahanifar,2025年). 总的来说,这些数据集包含多种组织类型、机构和成像域,为模仿症识别和域通化提供了一个具有挑战性的基准(Nasir等,2026年)。 表A.2概述了相应的数据集特征。

blocks.en: A multi-class classification dataset of single-cell images from breast cancer H&E slides. Its key feature is a hierarchical annotation scheme, with labels reviewed and confirmed by pathologists. This structure allows us to evaluate the representative power of our embeddings on both fine-grained (e.g., distinguishing immune cell types) and coarse-grained (e.g., tumour vs. stromal) classification tasks. We refer to them as NuCLS (super) for broad categories, NuCLS (main) for main cell type categories and NuCLS (raw) for fine-grained type and subtype classifications ( Amgad et al., 2022 ) . The dataset statistics are summarised in Table A.3 . In evaluation, we have reported the results only for NuCLS super category. However, the model can be used for other categories as well.
blocks.zh: 由乳腺癌H&E滑行而来单细胞影像的多类分类数据集. 其主要特征是分级注解方案,标签由病理学家审核确认. 这种结构使我们能够评价我们嵌入在细毛(如区分免疫细胞类型)和粗毛(如肿瘤与分泌)分类任务上的代表性能. 我们称之为大类的NuCLS(超级),主要细胞类型类的NuCLS(主要)和细纹型和亚型分类的NuCLS(粗) (Amgad等,2022年). 数据集统计摘要见表A.3。 在评价中,我们只报告了NuCLS超级类的结果. 然而,该模型也可以用于其他类别。

blocks.en: The MONKEY dataset was released for the MONKEY challenge Van Midden et al. (2026) and comprises periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-stained kidney slides for monocyte and lymphocyte detection and classification. Each WSI was scanned at a resolution of 0.24 mpp. Expert pathologists annotated the centroids of two cell types, lymphocytes and monocytes, across 231 large regions of interest from 153 WSIs collected at six pathology departments. Additional dataset details are summarised in Table A.6 .
blocks.zh: MONKEY数据集为MONKEY挑战范米登等人(2026年)发布,包含周期性酸-Schiff (PAS)-受污染的肾滑,用于单细胞和淋巴细胞检测和分类. 每个WSI都是以0.24 mpp的分辨率扫描. 专家病理学家在6个病理学系收集的153个WSI的231个大感兴趣区域中,对淋巴细胞和单细胞两种细胞类的百分行星进行了注释. 表A.6概述了其他数据集的详细情况。

blocks.en: Immunocto is the largest dataset of H&E-stained cell phenotypes derived from mIF cell annotations ( Simard et al., 2025 ) . It contains single-cell crops sized 64 × 64 64\times 64 px at 40 × 40\times magnification, along with nuclear masks and cell-phenotyping labels. The dataset contains 6.85M cell images, including more than 2.28M immune cells classified into four major populations: CD4 + T cells, CD8 + T cells, CD20 + B cells, and CD68 + /CD163 + macrophages. Its large scale and molecularly derived annotations make Immunocto a challenging benchmark for immune cell phenotyping. Dataset details are summarised in Table A.7 .
blocks.zh: Immunocto是由MIF细胞注解(Simard等,2025年)所衍生出H&E有斑细胞酚类的最大数据集. 它包含尺寸为64×64 64\times 64 px,以40×40\times放大的单细胞作物,并配有核口罩和细胞圈标签. 数据集包含6.85M细胞影像,包括超过2.28M免疫细胞被归类为四大类群: CD4 + T 单元格, CD8 + T 单元格, CD20 + B 单元格,和 CD68 + /CD163 + 宏phages. 它的大规模和分子衍生的说明使免疫细胞活性化(Immunocto)成为免疫细胞活性化的具有挑战性的基准. 数据集细节摘要见表A.7。

blocks.en: The PUMA dataset was released as part of the 2025 challenge ( Schuiveling et al., 2027 ) and contains H&E-stained images of advanced melanoma with nucleus-level annotations. The full dataset comprises 155 primary melanoma regions of interest (ROIs) and 155 metastatic melanoma ROIs spanning eight organs. Each ROI is of size 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 px and was scanned at 40 × \times magnification (0.22 mpp). Table A.8 provides statistical details of the dataset.
blocks.zh: PUMA数据集作为2025年挑战的一部分发布(Schuiveling等,2027年),并包含了高级黑色素瘤的H&E覆盖图像并有核层说明. 完整的数据集包括155个主要黑色素瘤区域(ROIs)和155个跨8个器官的元静态黑色素瘤区域(ROIs)。 每个ROI大小为1024×1024 1024\times 1024 px,被扫描为40×\tims放大(0.22 mpp). 表A.8提供了数据集的统计细节。

blocks.en: We note that PanNuke, NuCLS and the TCGA subset of the mitosis benchmark include images derived from TCGA slides, which may overlap with the pre-training corpus. As pre-training is fully self-supervised, no downstream labels are exposed to the encoder; nevertheless, to assess generalisation to unseen data, we also evaluate on CoNIC, MONKEY, Immunocto and PUMA, which originate from sources independent of TCGA. Additional details of these benchmark datasets is summarised in Table A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,PanNuke、NuCLS和Mitosis基准的TCGA子集包括取自TCGA幻灯片的图像,这些图像可能与培训前的表格相重叠。 由于前期培训是完全自我监督的,因此没有下游标签暴露在编码器上;然而,为了评估通用到隐蔽的数据,我们还对来自独立于TCGA的源头的CoNIC,MONKEY,Immunocto和PUMA进行了评价. 这些基准数据集的其他细节见表A.1。

blocks.en: For all benchmark datasets, 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell-centred crops were extracted from the provided images at each dataset’s native resolution, centred on the annotated nucleus centroid. For C-LiTE, these crops were used directly as input without resizing. For baseline models, crops were resized to each model’s native input resolution ( Table 1 ): 224 × 224 224\times 224 px for DINOv2, Phikon, UNI2, Virchow2, DinoBloom and CytoFormer, and 40 × 40 40\times 40 px for LEMON. Consequently, all models received the same field of view for each cell. We note that Immunocto, MONKEY and PUMA are acquired at approximately 0.22 0.22 – 0.25 0.25 mpp, whereas the C-LiTE pre-training corpus was extracted at 0.5 0.5 mpp; for these datasets, a 64 × 64 64\times 64 px crop therefore covers a smaller physical area (approximately 16 × 16 ​ μ 16\times 16~\mu m) than during pre-training (approximately 32 × 32 ​ μ 32\times 32~\mu m). The strong performance of C-LiTE on these benchmarks suggests that the learned representations are robust to this change in scale.
blocks.zh: 在所有基准数据集中,64×64 64\times 64 px以细胞为中心的作物是从每个数据集的原生分辨率所提供的图像中取出,其中心是注解的核心体。 对于C-LiTE来说,这些作物是直接用作投入而无需重新调整大小. 就基线模型而言,作物被调整到每个模型的原生输入分辨率(表1):DINov2、Phikon、UNI2、Virchow2、DinoBloom和CytoFormer为224×224\tims,LEMON为40×40\tims。 因此,每个单元格的所有模型都得到相同的视野。 我们注意到,Immunocto、MONKEY和PUMA的购买量约为0.22 0.22 – 0.25 0.25 mpp,而C-LiTE的预训书取出量为0.5 mpp;对这些数据集而言,64 × 64\times 64 px 作物覆盖的物理面积(约16 × 16 μ 16\tims 16\tims 16\tims mu m)比培训前的面积要小(约32 × 32 μ 32\tims 32\m)。 C-LiTE在这些基准方面的有力表现表明,汲取了教训的表述对规模的这一变化是强有力的。

blocks.zh: 5.1.3 评价计量

Balanced accuracy and macro F1 are defined here; the remaining metrics include AUROC, mAP, macro precision, macro recall, and weighted F1.

blocks.en: Mean per-slide GPU inference time was approximately 1.03 hours (measured on TCGA-BRCA). blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Table A.11 – Table A.17 summarise macro-F1 across the seven benchmarks, from which three consistent patterns emerge. First, despite its compact size, C-LiTE was competitive with the largest pathology foundation models throughout. It achieved the best macro-F1 on MIDOG (0.790 ± \pm 0.006), was effectively tied with CytoFormer on MONKEY (0.785 vs. 0.786), and outperformed every other 22M-parameter model on all seven benchmarks. Second, the effect of distillation depended on the task. C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} , distilled from UNI2, achieved the best macro-F1 of all models on PanNuke (0.743 ± \pm 0.005) and NuCLS (0.613 ± \pm 0.002), whereas on MIDOG, CoNIC and MONKEY, C-LiTE outperformed both C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} and its Virchow2-distilled counterpart, C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} . Third, CytoFormer led on the four remaining benchmarks (MONKEY, CoNIC, Immunocto and PUMA), but its margin over the best C-LiTE variant was substantial only on CoNIC (0.769 vs. 0.718 for C-LiTE); on Immunocto and PUMA the gap was 0.005 (C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} ) and 0.018 (C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} ), respectively.

blocks.en: These results are all the more notable given the difference in model size ( Fig. 5 ). C-LiTE, C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} and C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} each have 22M parameters, approximately 𝟑𝟎 × \mathbf{30\times} fewer than UNI2 and CytoFormer (681M) and 28 × 28\times fewer than Virchow2 (632M). Averaged across benchmarks, C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} (0.675) and C-LiTE (0.670) came within 0.012 of CytoFormer (0.682), and all three variants, including C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.655), exceeded UNI2 (0.646) and Virchow2 (0.628). Models of equal size fell well short (LEMON, 0.621; DinoBloom, 0.585; DINOv2 ViT-S/14, 0.542). Moreover, the distilled students generally surpassed their considerably larger teachers: C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} outperformed UNI2 on all seven benchmarks, and C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} outperformed Virchow2 on five. The following sections examine each task in turn.

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Normal vs. Atypical Mitosis Classification
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 正常与非典型的消毒分类

blocks.en: We begin with MIDOG, a clinically relevant binary task that requires distinguishing atypical from normal mitotic figures on the basis of subtle morphological differences, as shown in Table 2 . This task most clearly favoured cell-level representations. C-LiTE achieved the highest macro-F1 (0.790 ± \pm 0.006) and ranked first on every metric, followed by C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.786 ± \pm 0.007) and C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} (0.775 ± \pm 0.009). Even the 22M-parameter DinoBloom and LEMON (0.757 and 0.755) outperformed UNI2 (0.726) and Virchow2 (0.729), indicating that representations learned from whole tissue patches are less well suited to this fine morphological distinction. Distillation nonetheless transferred useful information, as C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} and C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} each improved substantially on their respective teachers. Per-class precision, recall and F1 are given in Table A.11 .
blocks.zh: 我们从MIDOG开始,这是一个临床上相关的二进制任务,需要根据微妙的形态差异来区分非典型数字和正常的相位数字,如表2所示。 这项任务最明显地倾向于在基层代表。 C-LiTE实现了最高的宏-F1 (0.790 ±\pm 0.006),并在每个公分量上排名第一,其次是C-LiTE * V ±V (0.786 ±\pm 0.007)和C-LiTE * U ±U (0.775 ±\pm 0.009). 甚至22M参数的DinoBloom和LEMON(0.757和0.755)的性能都超过了UNI2(0.726)和Virchow2(0.729),表明从整个组织补丁中吸取的表达力不太适合这种细微的形态区别. 尽管如此,蒸发还是转移了有用的信息,如C-LiTE * V-Q-V- 和C-LiTE * U- 每个人的教师都大有进步。 表A.11列出每类精度、召回和F1。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Hierarchical Nuclear Classification
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 等级核分类

blocks.en: NuCLS presents a contrasting picture. Its hierarchical nuclear taxonomy makes it one of the most difficult benchmarks, with no model exceeding a macro-F1 of 0.62, as shown in Table 3 . In this setting, patch-level models were as effective as cell-level ones: UNI2 (0.602 ± \pm 0.005), Virchow2 (0.600 ± \pm 0.008) and CytoFormer (0.598 ± \pm 0.005) performed almost identically. Distillation proved decisive. C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} achieved the highest macro-F1 of all models (0.613 ± \pm 0.002), surpassing its teacher UNI2, whereas C-LiTE (0.590 ± \pm 0.005) trailed the large models slightly. The difference appears to lie in minority-class performance. C-LiTE ranked second only to C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} in accuracy, AUROC and weighted F1, but its balanced accuracy (0.573) was lower than that of UNI2 (0.593), suggesting that distillation from UNI2 primarily improved recognition of the rarer classes. This benefit did not extend to C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.559), which fell below both C-LiTE and its teacher. Per-class results are reported in Table A.12 .

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Nuclei Classification
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 核子分类

blocks.en: The same pattern recurred on PanNuke, a pan-cancer nucleus classification benchmark evaluated with three-fold cross-validation, as shown in Table 4 . C-LiTE (0.713 ± \pm 0.003) matched UNI2 and CytoFormer (both 0.715), with the lowest variance across folds of any model. Distillation again yielded a clear gain: C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} achieved the highest macro-F1 of 0.743 ± \pm 0.005, followed by C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.723 ± \pm 0.005). As on NuCLS, the improvement came from minority classes rather than overall accuracy, which remained highest for UNI2; C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} instead led in balanced accuracy (0.734 vs. 0.705 for UNI2), mAP and macro precision. Per-class results are reported in Table A.13 .
blocks.zh: 如表4所显示的,在PanNuke上也重复出现同样的模式,即用三倍的交叉验证来评价的泛癌核分类基准。 C-LiTE(0.713±\pm 0.003)与UNI2和CytoFormer(均为0.715)相匹配,任何模型的折叠相差最小。 蒸发再次产生明显收益:C-LiTE *U QQU 实现最高的宏F1为0.743±pm 0.005,其次是C-LiTE *V QQ (0.723±pm 0.005). 关于NuCLS,改进来自少数群体类别,而不是总体准确度,对于UNI2来说,这仍然是最高的;C-LiTE * U QQU}^{*} 则在均衡准确度(UNI2为0.734比0.705)、mAP和宏观精确度方面领先。 按类别分列的结果见表A.13。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Linear-probe classification on PanNuke ( Gamper et al., 2020 ) . Best value per column in bold , second best underlined .
blocks.zh: 表4:潘努克上线性-probe分类(Gamper等,2020. 每栏最高值以粗体表示,第二高下划线。

blocks.en: CoNIC ( Graham et al., 2021 ) tests whether these gains persist under a finer taxonomy, as its six colon-specific classes resolve the single PanNuke inflammatory category into eosinophils, neutrophils, lymphocytes and plasma cells ( Table 5 ). Here, the effect of distillation was mixed. CytoFormer achieved the highest macro-F1 ( 0.769 ± 0.003 0.769\pm 0.003 ) and led on most metrics, with C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} second ( 0.727 ± 0.003 0.727\pm 0.003 ), followed by C-LiTE ( 0.718 ± 0.002 0.718\pm 0.002 ), C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} ( 0.683 ± 0.002 0.683\pm 0.002 ) and all remaining baselines, including UNI2 ( 0.682 0.682 ). C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} was the only model to exceed CytoFormer on accuracy (0.847 vs. 0.833) and weighted F1 (0.843 vs. 0.830), and it also improved on C-LiTE in balanced accuracy (0.701 vs. 0.693). In contrast, C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} attained higher accuracy than C-LiTE (0.825 vs. 0.813) but a markedly lower balanced accuracy (0.652 vs. 0.693). The per-class results show that both distilled variants improved on the abundant classes (connective, epithelial and lymphocyte), but only C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} matched C-LiTE on eosinophils, and both fell below it on neutrophils and plasma cells. CytoFormer retained a clear lead on these rare inflammatory subtypes. The difference between the two distilled variants may reflect their teachers, since UNI2 performs considerably better than Virchow2 on this benchmark, but we did not test this directly. Per-class results are reported in Table A.14 .
blocks.zh: CoNIC(Graham等,2021年)测试这些增益在更细的分类学下是否持续,因为其6个结肠特异性分类将单一的PanNuke炎症类别分解为嗜血杆菌,中营养素,淋巴细胞和等离子细胞(表5). 在这里,蒸馏的效果是混合的. CytoFormer实现了最高的宏观-F1 (0.769±0.003\pm 0.003),并领先于大多数的公分数,其中C-LiTE * U-U-U-U-U- 的第二位(0.727±0.003\pm 0.727\pm.003),C-LiTE(0.718±0.002\pm 0.002),C-LTE * V-V-Q(0.683±0.0020.683/pm 0.002)和所有剩余基线,包括UNI2(0.682 0.682 6.682). C-LiTE *U QQU}^{*}是精确度(0.847对0.833)和加权F1(0.843对0.830)上唯一能超过CytoFormer的型号,它也在平衡精确度(0.701对0.693)上改进了C-LiTE. 反之,C-LiTE *V {}_{. VQQ的精确度高于C-LiTE(0.825对0.813),但平衡度明显较低(0.652对0.693)。 每类的结果显示,两种蒸馏变体在丰富的类上(连接型,上皮型和淋巴细胞型)都有所改进,但只有C-LiTE * U-Q-U-}^{*}在异氨基苯上与C-LiTE相匹配,在中皮细胞和等离子细胞上均跌入其下. CytoFormer在这些罕见的煽动性亚型上保留了明显的领先. 这两个蒸馏变体之间的区别可能反映了它们的老师,因为UNI2在这个基准上的表现比Virchow2要好很多,但我们并没有直接测试这一点. 表A.14报告了每类结果。

blocks.en: 5.2.4 Immune Cell Classification
blocks.zh: 5.2.4 免疫细胞分类

blocks.en: We next examined immune cells more directly, beginning with MONKEY, a binary lymphocyte-monocyte task, as shown in Table 6 . As on MIDOG, cell-level models held a clear advantage. CytoFormer (0.786 ± \pm 0.002), C-LiTE (0.785 ± \pm 0.001) and C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} (0.784 ± \pm 0.002) performed on par, with LEMON (0.777 ± \pm 0.002) and C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.774 ± \pm 0.004) close behind, whereas UNI2 (0.744 ± \pm 0.004) and Virchow2 (0.723 ± \pm 0.003) trailed substantially. Within this leading group, C-LiTE achieved the highest AUROC (0.879) and macro precision (0.799) of all models. Per-class results are reported in Table A.15 .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来更直接地检查免疫细胞,从MONKEY开始,这是一个二元淋巴细胞-细胞任务,见表6。 与MIDOG一样,细胞级模型具有明显的优势. CytoFormer (0.786 ±\pm 0.002), C-LiTE (0.785 ±\pm 0.001)和 C-LiTE → U → U (0.784 ±\pm 0.002) 在平地上表演, LEMON (0.777 ±\pm 0.002) 和 C-LiTE → V (0.774 ±\pm 0.004) 紧随其后,而 UNI2(0.744 ±\pm 0.004) 和 Virchow 2 (0.723 ±\pm 0.003) 则大量出轨. 在这个领先集团中,C-LiTE实现了最高的AUROC(0.879)和宏观精确度(0.799)所有模型. 表A.15报告了每类结果。

blocks.zh: 表6: MONKEY上的线性探测分类。 每栏最高值以粗体表示,第二高下划线。

blocks.en: 5.2.5 Immune Cell Phenotyping - Immunocto
blocks.zh: 5.2.5 免疫细胞形态 -- -- 免疫细胞

blocks.en: Immunocto extends this evaluation to fine-grained immune phenotyping at scale. Owing to its size (6.85M cells), it was evaluated on a single split following the original paper ( Simard et al., 2025 ) , and no standard deviations are therefore reported ( subsubsection 5.1.3 , Table 7 ). CytoFormer led on every metric (0.574), consistent with its transcriptomics-derived supervision, which directly targets molecularly defined immune populations. C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.569), C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} (0.567) and C-LiTE (0.557) followed closely and outperformed all other models by a wide margin, including UNI2 (0.510) and Virchow2 (0.461). In contrast to CoNIC, distillation was beneficial here, and the gains over the teachers were the largest of any benchmark: C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} exceeded Virchow2 by 0.108 and C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} exceeded UNI2 by 0.057. Per-class results are reported in Table A.16 .
blocks.zh: Immunocto将这一评价扩展到了规模上精细的免疫层. 由于其体积(6.85M细胞),它在原论文(Simard等,2025年)后被单独分出一个细胞来评价,因此没有报告标准偏差(第5.1.3分节,表7.). CytoFormer领导了每个公分量(0.574),符合其直指分子定义的免疫人群的成像仪所衍生出的监督. C-LiTE * V {}_{V}^{*} (0.569), C-LiTE * U {}_{U}^{*} (0.567)和 C-LiTE (0.557) 紧随其后,以相去甚远的优势超过了所有其他模型,包括UNI2(0.510)和Virchow2(0.461). 与CONIC不同,蒸馏在这里是有好处的,对教师的增益是任何基准中最大的:C-LiTE ∗ V-Q-V-}^{*}以0.108超过Virchow2,C-LiTE *U-Q-U-}^{*}以0.057超过UNI2. 表A.16报告了每类结果。

blocks.zh: 表7:免疫球菌的线性-概率分类(Simard等,2025年) . 每栏最高值以粗体表示,第二高下划线。

blocks.en: 5.2.6 Multi-Organ Nuclear Phenotyping (PUMA)
blocks.zh: 5.2.6 多组织核发作

blocks.en: Finally, PUMA is the most fine-grained benchmark in our study, comprising ten nuclear phenotypes across multiple tissue compartments, as shown in Table 8 . CytoFormer again achieved the highest macro-F1 (0.575), followed by C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} (0.557). C-LiTE (0.540) performed on par with UNI2 (0.543) and Virchow2 (0.539), trading higher macro precision (0.611) for lower balanced accuracy (0.503), and substantially outperformed LEMON (0.438) and DinoBloom (0.436). As on NuCLS, distillation from UNI2 helped whereas distillation from Virchow2 did not, with C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} (0.492) falling below its teacher. Per-class results are reported in Table A.17 .
blocks.zh: 最后,如表8所示,PUMA是我们研究中最精细的基准,由跨越多组织区块的10个核酚类组成。 CytoFormer再次实现了最高的宏-F1 (0.575),其次是C-LiTE * U-Q-U-(0.557). C-LiTE(0.540)与UNI2(0.543)和Virchow2(0.539)进行对等操作,交易的宏观精度较高(0.611),平衡精度较低(0.503),而且LEMON(0.438)和DinoBloom(0.436)。 至于NuCLS,UNI2的蒸馏有帮助,而Virchow2的蒸馏没有帮助,因为C-LiTE * V {}_{ VQ (0.492) 倒下它的老师。 表A.17报告了每类结果。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Linear-probe classification on PUMA. Best value per column in bold , second best underlined .
blocks.zh: 表8:PUMA上的线性探测分类. 每栏最高值以粗体表示,第二高下划线。

blocks.en: The per-class results help explain these benchmark-level differences. Across benchmarks, performance was lowest on minority and morphologically ambiguous classes, such as CD8 + T cells (best F1 0.269) and macrophages (best F1 below 0.47) in Immunocto, endothelium in PUMA (0.40), and the ambiguous class in NuCLS (0.40). These classes also account for much of CytoFormer’s advantage. It retained a clear lead on eosinophils, neutrophils and plasma cells in CoNIC, CD8 + T cells in Immunocto, and epithelial cells and histiocytes in PUMA, which may reflect its greater capacity as well as its molecularly informed supervision. The value of cell-level pre-training is equally evident at this level: natural-image backbones reached F1 scores of only 0.31–0.41 for CoNIC eosinophils and neutrophils, compared with 0.841 and 0.753 for CytoFormer and 0.701 and 0.662 for C-LiTE.
blocks.zh: 每个类别的结果有助于解释这些基准水平的差异。 在各种基准中,少数民族和形态模糊类的性能最低,如:Immunocto的CD8 + T细胞(最佳F1 0.269)和宏phages(最佳F1 低于0.47),PUMA的内分泌(0.40)和NuCLS的模糊类(0.40)。 这些课程也占据了CytoFormer的大部分优势. 它保留了CoNIC的异生体、中微子体和等离子体细胞、Immunocto的CD8 + T细胞以及PUMA的上位细胞和组织细胞的明显铅,这可能反映其更大的能力和分子上知情的监督。 细胞级前期训练的价值在这个级别上同样明显:自然成像骨干只达到F1分0.31–0.41分,CoNIC异生和中微营养素,而CytoFormer则达到0.841分和0.753分,C-LiTE则达到0.701分和0.662分.

blocks.en: Conversely, C-LiTE achieved the highest F1 of all methods for both MIDOG classes and for three of the four NuCLS classes, matched CytoFormer on MONKEY lymphocytes, and led on lymphocytes, melanophage and stroma in PUMA. On PanNuke, it led only on the inflammatory class, whereas the rare dead-cell class was best recognised by C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} (F1 0.699), in line with the minority-class gains from distillation observed on NuCLS and PanNuke.
blocks.zh: 反之,C-LiTE在MIDOG两个班和4个NuCLS班中的3个班都实现了所有方法中最高的F1,在MONKEY淋巴细胞上与CytoFormer相匹配,并领导了PUMA的淋巴细胞,黑色和斯通. 在PanNuke上,它只领导了煽动性阶级,而罕见的死细胞阶级则得到C-LiTE * U QQU}^{*} (F1 0.699)的最好认可,这符合在NuCLS和PanNuke上观察到的从蒸馏得到的少数阶级的收获.

blocks.en: 5.3 Embedding Space Visualisation
blocks.zh: 5.3 嵌入空间可视化

blocks.en:
To complement the quantitative evaluation, we qualitatively examine the geometry of the learnt embedding space using UMAP projections of C-LiTE cell embeddings. We examine whether the embedding space organises cells by morphological structures, and whetehr cells of the same tissue type cluster together.
As shown in Fig. 6 , the C-LiTE representation forms visibly compact and separable clusters by cell type, with no distinguishable residual grouping by tissue.
blocks.zh:
为了补充定量评估,我们利用UMAP对C-LiTE细胞嵌入的预测,对所学到的嵌入空间的几何进行了定性审查。 我们研究嵌入空间是否通过形态结构来组织细胞, 以及同一组织类型组群的鲸鱼细胞。
如图6所示,C-LiTE的表达形式按细胞类型明显地形成紧凑和可分离的集群,没有按组织分列的可分辨的残余集群.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : UMAP projection of cell embeddings. (A) Colored by cell types extracted from C-LiTE. (B) Colored by tissue types.
blocks.zh: 图6:UMAP对细胞嵌入的预测. (A)由从C-LiTE中取取的细胞类型所取出色. (B) 有颜色的组织类型。

blocks.en: 5.4 Inference Speed and Latency
blocks.zh: 5.4 推断速度和延迟

blocks.en: We benchmark inference efficiency for C-LiTE and CytoFormer under matched hardware (a single NVIDIA A100 GPU) and precision, measuring parameter count, FLOPs, throughput and peak GPU memory. For both models, the batch size is set to the largest value that fits in available GPU memory, and throughput is reported at that batch size. Table 9 summarises the comparison. While trailing CytoFormer by only 0.012 average macro-F1, C-LiTE uses 30 × 30\times fewer parameters, requires 16.2 × 16.2\times fewer FLOPs per input, achieves 21.1 × 21.1\times higher throughput and consumes 6.0 × 6.0\times less GPU memory. This gap is consistent with CytoFormer’s encoder being initialised from UNI2-h, a 681M-parameter ViT-H architecture, and fine-tuned end-to-end with per-organ classification heads, whereas C-LiTE is initialised from a 22M-parameter ViT-5-S and pre-trained with self-supervision on cell crops. These results indicate that C-LiTE offers a substantially more favourable accuracy-efficiency trade-off than any other method achieving comparable downstream performance, making it considerably more practical for large-scale, cell-level analysis of WSIs.
blocks.zh: 我们在匹配的硬件(单NVIDIA A100 GPU)和精度,参数计数,FLOPs,吞吐量和峰值GPU内存下,将C-LiTE和CytoFormer的基准推导效率作为基准. 对于两种型号,分批量大小被设定为与可用的GPU内存相匹配的最大值,而吞吐量则被报告为分批量. 表9概述了比较情况。 虽然CytoFormer仅落后于0.012个平均宏-F1,C-LiTE使用30×30\的参数更少,但每次输入需要16.2×16.2\的FLOP,实现21.1×21.1\的吞吐量,消耗6.0×6.0\的GPU内存更少. 这一差距与CytoFormer的编码器从UNI2-h(681M参数的Vit-H架构)中关闭一致,并与每个组织的分类头对端到端进行微调,而C-LiTE则从22M参数的Vit-5-S中关闭,并预先对细胞作物进行自我监督培训。 这些结果表明,C-LiTE提供了比任何其他实现下游类似性能的方法更有利的精确效率取舍,使得对WSI进行大规模细胞级分析更为实际.

blocks.zh: 表9:C-LiTE和CytoFormer的效率比较。 在每一个模型的本地输入分辨率上对一个NVIDIA A100 GPU进行的所有测量;批量大小是可用GPU内存中最大的配位.

blocks.en: 5.5 Ablation
blocks.zh: 5.5 违约

blocks.en: We conducted a series of ablation experiments to investigate the effects of input crop resolution, patch size, and patch-embedding initialisation on the quality of the learned representations. All configurations were evaluated using the same linear-probing protocol and performance metrics described in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一系列减肥实验,以调查输入作物分辨率、补丁大小和补丁嵌入初始化对所学到的表述质量的影响。 所有配置均使用第5节所描述的相同线性测试协议和性能度量度来评价.

blocks.en: 5.5.1 Ablation Configurations
blocks.zh: 5.5.1 阅读配置

blocks.en: Throughout this section, configurations are denoted using the format Backbone / Patch Size / Crop Size, specifying the backbone architecture, patch-embedding dimensions, and input crop dimensions, respectively. All spatial dimensions are expressed in pixels. For example, ViT-S / Patch14 / Crop256 denotes a ViT-S backbone with a 14 × 14 14\times 14 px patch embedding and a 256 × 256 256\times 256 px input crop. Figure 1 provides a visual overview of the different configurations evaluated in the ablation study.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,配置使用Backbone / Patch Size / Crop Size格式表示,分别指定了主干架构,补丁嵌入维度,和输入裁剪维度. 所有空间维度均以像素来表示. 例如,VIT-S / Patch14 / Crop256表示一个VIT-S主干,有14×14 14\times 14 px补丁嵌入和256×256\times 256 px输入收成. 图1以视觉方式综述了在开发研究中评价的不同配置.

blocks.en: We first established a reference configuration using a standard ViT-S backbone with its native patch size of 14 and an input resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 px. The subsequent experiments employed ViT-5-S, the pre-trained backbone used in the final C-LiTE architecture. To assess the effect of input resolution, we evaluated three crop sizes ( 224 × 224 224\times 224 , 96 × 96 96\times 96 , and 64 × 64 64\times 64 px), while keeping the patch size fixed at 16. This comparison enabled us to examine the effect of reducing the input resolution while maintaining a constant patch-embedding configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用标准的VIT-S主干线建立了参考配置,其原生补丁尺寸为14个,输入分辨率为256×256256\times 256px. 随后的实验采用了ViT-5-S,这是最终C-LiTE架构中使用的预训骨干. 为了评估输入分辨率的效果,我们评价了三种作物尺寸(224×224×时;96×96×时;64×64×时;64px),同时将补丁尺寸固定为16. 通过这一比较,我们可以在保持连续的补丁嵌入配置的同时,审查减少输入分辨率的效果。

blocks.en: We next investigated the effect of reducing the patch size to 4, while retaining the ViT-5-S backbone and 64 × 64 64\times 64 px input resolution. This configuration corresponds to the fine-grained tokenisation strategy adopted in C-LiTE. To evaluate the contribution of Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse-based patch-embedding initialisation, we compared two configurations that differed only in the initialisation of the patch projection: random initialisation (ViT-5-S / Patch4 / Crop64, w/o PI-PatchEmbed) and pseudoinverse-based transfer of the pre-trained patch-embedding weights (ViT-5-S / Patch4 / Crop64 + PI-PatchEmbed). This controlled comparison isolates the contribution of PI-PatchEmbed to representation quality. The latter configuration corresponds to the complete C-LiTE architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来调查了将补丁大小缩小为4,同时保留了VIT-5-S主干线和64×64-times 64px输入分辨率的效果. 此配置对应了C-LiTE采用的精细标致策略. 为了评价Moore-Penrose伪反向补丁嵌入初始化的贡献,我们比较了两个仅在补丁投影初始化中存在差异的配置:随机初始化(ViT-5-S / Patch4 / Crop64,w/o PI-Patch-Embed)和预训补丁嵌入重量(ViT-5-S / Patch4 / Crop64 + PI-Patch-Embed)的伪反向转移. 这种受控比较隔离了PI-PatchEmbed对表现质量的贡献. 后一配置对应完整的C-LiTE架构.

blocks.en: The ablations indicate that C-LiTE’s advantage stems primarily from fine patch granularity, with PI-PatchEmbed initialisation providing a further smaller gain. Three effects, consistent across benchmarks, support this conclusion.
blocks.zh: C-LiTE的优势主要源于精细的补丁颗粒性, 三个影响,即各种基准一致,都支持这一结论。

blocks.en: Cropping to cell scale alone was detrimental. With the patch size fixed at 16, reducing the crop from 224 to 64 px, which leaves a grid of only 4 × 4 4\times 4 tokens, lowered macro-F1 on every benchmark where this configuration was evaluated. Reducing the patch size to 4 at the same crop reversed this loss: the resulting 16 × 16 16\times 16 token grid improved macro-F1 on all benchmarks where the comparison was available, and this was the largest single effect on all of them except PanNuke. The improvement is not merely a consequence of sequence length. Patch16/Crop224 produces a comparable number of tokens ( 14 × 14 14\times 14 ), yet Patch4/Crop64 clearly outperformed both on CoNIC, MIDOG, and NuCLS. The key consideration, therefore, is the spatial resolution at which individual cells are represented. Finally, initialising the 4 × 4 4\times 4 patch projection with PI-PatchEmbed instead of random initialisation improved macro-F1 on five of the seven datasets and left it unchanged on PUMA. The strength of these effects varied considerably between benchmarks, as described below.
blocks.zh: 光是作物到细胞尺度就有害。 随着补丁大小被固定为16个,将收成从224个px减少到64个px,这只留下了4×4 4\times 4个令牌的网格,将宏-F1降低到每个评价此配置的基准上. 在同一作物上将补丁尺寸缩小为4,扭转了这一损失:结果的16×16 16\times 16令牌网格改进了所有基准上的宏-F1,这是除PanNuke外对所有这些基准最大的单一效应. 改进不仅仅是序列长度的结果。 Patch16/Crop224产生相仿的代号(14×14 14\times 14),然而Patch4/Crop64在CoNIC,MIDOG,和NuCLS上的表现都明显优于. 因此,关键考虑因素是单个细胞的空间分辨率。 最后,用PI-PatchEmbed来初始化4×4 4\times 4补丁投影,而不是随机初始化,在7个数据集的5个上改进了宏-F1,并在PUMA上保留了不变. 如下文所述,这些影响的力量在基准之间差别很大。

blocks.en: The effects were largest on CoNIC ( Table 10 ). Resizing the crops from 224 to 64 px at patch size 16 reduced macro-F1 from 0.654 to 0.567, the largest drop observed on any benchmark. Reducing the patch size to 4 more than recovered this loss, raising macro-F1 to 0.701, and PI-PatchEmbed initialisation added a further 0.017, bringing C-LiTE to 0.718.
blocks.zh: 对CoNIC的影响最大(表10)。 将作物从224平方厘米调整为64平方厘米,以补丁尺寸为16,将宏-F1从0.654降至0.567,这是任何基准上观察到的最大下降. 将补丁尺寸缩小到4个以上,超过收回这一损失,将宏-F1提高到0.701,而PI-Patch-Embed初始化又增加了0.017,使C-LiTE达到0.718.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Ablation over patch size, crop size and patch-embedding initialisation on CoNIC ( Graham et al., 2021 ) . Best value per column in bold . C-LiTE rows match Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 表10:在CoNIC上超过补丁大小、作物大小和补丁嵌入初始化(Graham等,2021年)。 每栏最高值以粗体表示。 C-LiTE行与表5相匹配.

blocks.en: MONKEY dataset showed a same pattern with smaller magnitudes ( Table 11 ). The crop reduction lowered macro-F1 from 0.779 to 0.737, and finer patches more than recovered this loss (0.782). PI-PatchEmbed contributed only 0.003, so almost all of the improvement on this benchmark came from the finer patches.
blocks.zh: MONKEY数据集显示的型号较小(表11)。 作物减产将宏观F1从0.779降至0.737,更细的补丁超过收回的损失(0.782)。 PI 批量 嵌入只贡献了0.003分,因此这个基准上几乎所有的改进都出自更细的补丁.

blocks.en: Table 11 : Ablation over patch size, crop size and patch-embedding initialisation on MONKEY ( Van Midden et al., 2026 ) . Best value per column in bold . C-LiTE rows match Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 表11:在MONKEY上超过补丁大小、作物大小和补丁嵌入初始化(Van Midden等人,2026年)。 每栏最高值以粗体表示。 C-LiTE行与表6相匹配.

blocks.en: On MIDOG ( Table 12 ), finer patches raised macro-F1 from 0.679 to 0.781, 0.045 above the best patch-16 configuration. With PI-PatchEmbed, C-LiTE reached 0.790, the highest value of any configuration on this benchmark, including the distilled variants.
blocks.zh: 在MIDOG(表12)上,更细的补丁将宏-F1从0.679提高到了0.781,0.045以上最好的补丁-16配置. 随着PI-PatchEmbed,C-LiTE达到了0.790,是这个基准上任何配置的最高值,包括被蒸馏的变体.

blocks.en: Table 12 : Ablation over patch size, crop size and patch-embedding initialisation on MIDOG ( Aubreville et al., 2026 ) . Best value per column in bold . C-LiTE rows match Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 表12:在MIDOG上超过补丁大小、作物大小和补丁嵌入初始化(Aubreville等人,2026年)。 每栏最高值以粗体表示。 C-LiTE行与表2相匹配.

blocks.en: PanNuke was the exception ( Table 13 ). All non-distilled configurations lay within a narrow range (0.698–0.713), and the patch-size reduction alone gained only 0.004, leaving the randomly initialised patch-4 model below Patch16/Crop224 (0.702 vs. 0.708). Only with PI-PatchEmbed (0.713) did it surpass all patch-16 configurations and the ViT-S reference. For PanNuke’s five broad classes, which are largely separable at coarse resolution, the pre-trained patch projection thus mattered more than patch granularity.
blocks.zh: 潘努克是例外(表13)。 所有非抖动配置都位于狭长范围内(0.698–0.713),仅补丁大小的缩减就只得到0.004分,使得Patch16/Crop224(0.702 vs. 0.708)下方的随机待发补丁-4型. 仅用PI-PatchEmbed(0.713)就超过了所有补丁-16配置和Vit-S参考. 对PanNuke的五大类来说,这些类在粗细的分辨率下基本上可以分离出来,因此,预先训练的补丁投影比补丁颗粒性更重要.

blocks.en: Table 13 : Ablation over patch size, crop size and patch-embedding initialisation on PanNuke ( Gamper et al., 2020 ) . Best value per column in bold . C-LiTE rows match Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 表13:PanNuke上的补丁大小、作物大小和补丁嵌入初始化(Gamper等,2020年)。 每栏最高值以粗体表示。 C-LiTE行与表4相匹配.

blocks.en: NuCLS, by contrast, benefited strongly from both factors ( Table 14 ). Macro-F1 was nearly flat across the patch-16 configurations (0.437–0.456) but rose to 0.564 with patch size 4. PI-PatchEmbed then produced its largest gain of any benchmark, lifting macro-F1 to 0.590 and balanced accuracy from 0.559 to 0.573.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,NuCLS则从这两个因素中大大受益(表14)。 Macro-F1在补丁-16配置(0.437–0.456)上几乎是平的,但随着补丁大小而上升至0.564 4. PI-Patch项目 嵌入后产生了任何基准的最大收益,将宏-F1提升到0.590,平衡精确度从0.559提高到0.573.

blocks.en: Table 14 : Ablation over patch size, crop size and patch-embedding initialisation on NuCLS ( Amgad et al., 2022 ) . Best value per column in bold . C-LiTE rows match Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 表14:在NuCLS上的补丁大小、作物大小和补丁嵌入初始化(Amgad等,2022年) 每栏最高值以粗体表示。 C-LiTE行与表3相匹配.

blocks.en: On PUMA ( Table 15 ), where Patch16/Crop64 was not evaluated, differences between configurations were small. The patch-4 configuration (0.540) outperformed Patch16/Crop96 (0.534) and Patch16/Crop224 (0.526), and PI-PatchEmbed left macro-F1 unchanged while improving mAP from 0.573 to 0.585.
blocks.zh: 在PUMA(表15)中,Patch16/Crop64没有被评价,配置之间的差异很小. 补丁-4配置(0.540)优于Patch16/Crop96(0.534)和Patch16/Crop224(0.526),而PI-Patch-Embed在改进从0.573到0.585的mAP的同时,未变出宏-F1.

blocks.en: Table 15 : Ablation over patch size, crop size and patch-embedding initialisation on PUMA ( Schuiveling et al., 2027 ) . Best value per column in bold . C-LiTE rows match Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 表15:PUMA上的补丁大小、作物大小和补丁嵌入初始化(Schuiveling等人,2027年)。 每栏最高值以粗体表示。 C-LiTE行与表8相匹配.

blocks.en: Across these six benchmarks, distillation did not consistently improve on C-LiTE. C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} achieved higher macro-F1 on PanNuke (0.743 vs. 0.713), NuCLS (0.613 vs. 0.590) and PUMA (0.557 vs. 0.540) but lower macro-F1 on CoNIC, MONKEY and MIDOG, whereas C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} improved only on PanNuke (0.723) and declined most on PUMA (0.492).
blocks.zh: 在这6个基准中,蒸馏在C-LiTE方面没有持续改善。 C-LiTE *U QQU}^{*}在PanNuke(0.743 vs. 0.713),NuCLS(0.613 vs. 0.590)和PUMA(0.557 vs. 0.540)上实现了更高的宏观-F1,但在CoNIC,MONKEY和MIDOG上实现了较低的宏观-F1,而C-LTE * V . VQQ只在PanNuke(0.723)上有所改进,在PUMA(0.492)上下降最多.

blocks.en: Overall, the full C-LiTE configuration was the best non-distilled configuration on five of the seven datasets and tied for best on PUMA, confirming that both design choices contribute, with their relative importance depending on the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,完整的C-LiTE配置是7个数据集中5个组合中最好的非抖动配置,并捆绑在PUMA上的最佳配置,证实两个设计选择都有贡献,其相对重要性取决于基准.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Characterising individual cells at scale is central to computational pathology. Nuclear morphology, mitotic activity and immune composition all inform diagnosis, prognosis and treatment decisions. Yet a single WSI can contain thousands of nuclei, and each must be represented before it can be analysed. Although existing foundation models provide transferable representations, most were developed for tissue-level inputs and can be computationally expensive when applied at the cellular level. This raises an important question: are large foundation models necessary to obtain high-quality cellular representations, or can a more compact architecture, specifically designed for cell-level analysis, achieve comparable performance?.
blocks.zh: 在尺度上描述单个细胞是计算病理学的核心. 核形态、线粒体活性和免疫组成都为诊断、预测和治疗决定提供了依据。 然而,一个单一的WSI可以包含上千个核子,每个核子在分析之前都必须有代表. 虽然现有的基础模型提供了可转移的表示,但大多数是针对组织层面的投入而开发的,在细胞层面应用时计算成本可能很高。 这提出了一个重要的问题:大基础模型是获得高质量细胞表现所必需的,还是一个专门为细胞级分析设计的更紧凑的架构能够实现可比较的性能?

blocks.en:
In this paper, we have proposed C-LiTE, a light-weight cell-centric foundation model. C-LiTE adapts ViT-5-S to 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell crops through a 4 × 4 4\times 4 patch projection initialised with PI-PatchEmbed for projecting pre-trained model weights during initialisation.
It is pre-trained via SSL with DINO and iBOT objectives on approximately 60M cells from 19 cancer types. We have shown that C-LiTE performs comparably to the largest cell-level model while using 30 × 30\times fewer parameters. On average, it also outperforms the tissue-level foundation models evaluated. This suggests that, at the cellular scale, adapting the input representation and model architecture to the characteristics of individual cells may be more consequential than increasing model capacity.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了C-LiTE,一种以轻量级细胞为中心的基础模型. C-LiTE通过4×4 4 4\times 4补丁投放方式将ViT-5-S调整为64×64 64\times 64 px细胞收成,与PI-PatchEmbed合并为PI-PatchEmbed,用于在初始化期间投影预试模型重量.
它通过SSL进行预训,目标为DINO和iBOT,来自19种癌症的约60M细胞. 我们已经证明,C-LiTE在使用30×30\的参数的同时,可以与最大的单元格级模型进行比较。 平均来说,它的表现也超过了所评价的组织一级基础模型。 这表明,在细胞规模上,使输入表示和模型架构适应单个细胞的特征可能比增强模型能力更具影响.

blocks.en: The patch size determines how much of each cell a single token represents. At 0.5 mpp, a 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch spans 8 ​ μ 8~\mu m, roughly the diameter of a nucleus. Each token then summarises a whole nucleus, leaving no room to model its internal structure. A 4 × 4 4\times 4 patch spans 2 ​ μ 2~\mu m at this scale; the model can capture chromatin texture and membrane contour, the features pathologists use to separate, for example, atypical from normal mitoses. Our ablations support this view, as the finer patch outperformed configurations with similar or larger token grids. Fine spatial granularity, rather than a longer token sequence, is therefore the key design choice at cellular resolution. The same reasoning may explain why LEMON, which represents each nucleus with only 25 tokens, trailed on the more fine-grained benchmarks. It also exposes a weakness of upsampling cell crops to 224 × 224 224\times 224 px for tissue-level models, which raises computational cost but adds no information. PI-PatchEmbed makes native-resolution processing practical. It transfers pre-trained filters to the finer patch size, so the patch projection does not have to be learned from scratch.
blocks.zh: 补丁大小决定每个单元格中单个符号代表多少. 在0.5 mpp时,一个16×16 16\时的16个补丁跨度为8μ 8~\m,大致为核糖体的直径. 每一个符号然后概括出整个核子,没有空间来模拟其内部结构. 4×4 4\times 4的补丁在这个尺度上跨出2μ 2. ~\mu;该模型可以捕捉克罗马汀纹理和膜轮廓,特征病理学家用来分出,例如非典型与普通的相模. 我们的缩写支持这个观点,因为更精细的补丁在配置上超过了类似或更大的符号网格. 因此,精细的空间颗粒性,而不是更长的符号序列,是蜂窝分辨率的关键设计选择. 同样的推理可以解释为什么LEMON只代表25个符号的每个核子,跟随更精细的基准. 这也暴露出细胞收成提升的弱点为组织级模型的224×224\times 224px,这提高了计算成本,但没有添加信息. PI 批量 嵌入使本土分辨率处理实用. 它会将预先训练的滤波器转移到更细的补丁尺寸上,因此补丁投影不必从零开始学习.

blocks.en: Resolving a cell finely determines how well a model can see it. What the model needs to see depends on the task. For some tasks, cell identity lies in the cell itself. Mitoses, lymphocytes and monocytes fall into this group, and cell-level models were clearly favoured on them. For other tasks, classes reflect the surrounding tissue, as in the broad NuCLS categories. Patch-level models were competitive here, because their features link each cell to its micro-environment. For a third group, identity is defined by molecular markers. CD4 + and CD8 + T cells, for instance, are nearly indistinguishable in H&E. CytoFormer’s transcriptomics-derived supervision gives it an advantage on such cells that a morphology-only model may never fully close. Still, C-LiTE produces results close to CytoFormer on Immunocto, which suggests that much of this molecular signal leaves a visible trace in morphology. These three sources of identity, cellular, contextual and molecular, provide a useful lens for choosing a model for a given task.
blocks.zh: 细胞的溶解精细地决定了模型能看多好. 模型需要看到的取决于任务. 对于一些任务,细胞身份存在于细胞本身. 米托斯,淋巴细胞和单细胞都属于这个组,细胞级模型明显被青睐于它们. 对于其他任务,如在广义的NuCLS分类中,班级反映了周围的组织. 补丁级模型在此具有竞争力,因为它们的特性将每个细胞与它的微观环境联系起来。 对于第三组,身份由分子标记来定义. 例如,CD4 + 和CD8 + T细胞在H&E中几乎无法区分. CytoFormer的转录基因学监督使这种细胞有一个优势,即只有形态学模型可能永远不会完全关闭。 尽管如此,C-LiTE在Immunocto上产生与CytoFormer相近的结果,这表明这些分子信号中的大部分在形态学上留下了明显的痕迹. 这三种身份来源,即细胞,上下文和分子,为选择特定任务的模型提供了有用的透镜.

blocks.en:
The same perspective helps explain the mixed effects of distillation. By transferring a tissue-level teacher’s representations to the student, distillation can provide contextual information that complements cell morphology. Such cues are particularly valuable for distinguishing minority classes whose nuclear appearances overlap with those of more prevalent classes as well as for identifying cells through their spatial relationships and surrounding tissue environment. This may explain why distillation improved minority-class recognition on benchmarks with broad nuclear categories, where tissue context provides useful additional evidence for classification. On the fine-grained inflammatory subtypes of CoNIC, which depend on subtle cellular detail Laviron et al. (2022) ; Pochet et al. (2024) , it reduced performance.
The teachers saw upsampled crops, so the students may inherit tissue-scale biases that pre-training at native resolution does not fully remove. The students nonetheless often outperformed their much larger teachers. Cell-level pre-training thus appears to adapt the teacher’s representation to the cellular scale rather than merely compressing it. In practice, C-LiTE is the more robust default, while C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} may suit tasks with broad categories and severe class imbalance.
blocks.zh:
同样的观点有助于解释蒸馏的混合效果. 通过向学生转移组织级教师的表示,蒸馏可以提供补充细胞形态的上下文信息. 这种提示对于区分那些其核外观与更普遍的类别重叠的少数群体群体,以及对于通过其空间关系和周围组织环境识别细胞来说,特别有价值。 这或许可以解释为什么蒸馏方法提高了少数阶级对具有广泛核类别的基准的认识,因为组织背景为分类提供了有用的额外证据。 在CONIC的细纹炎症亚型上,它依赖于微妙的细胞细节Laviron等 (2022年);Pochet等 (2024年),它降低了性能.
教师们看到作物被取样,因此学生们可能继承了组织规模的偏见,这些偏见是先入为主的培训不能完全消除的。 然而,学生的成绩往往比教师大得多。 因此,细胞层面的预培训似乎使教师的表述与细胞尺度相适应,而不仅仅是对其进行压缩。 在实际操作中,C-LiTE是更强的默认,而C-LiTE *U QQU}^{*} 可能适合具有广泛类别和严重阶级不平衡的任务.

blocks.en: C-LiTE embeds one million cells in approximately 16 minutes on a single A100 GPU ( subsection 5.4 ), compared with about 5.6 hours for CytoFormer. It must be noted that absolute timings depend on hardware, batch size and implementation. The relative difference reflects the gap in computational cost and should hold across settings. C-LiTE can represent each detected cell with a general-purpose embedding, enabling label-free phenotyping, morphological profiling and spatial analysis. Reducing inference cost in this way also aligns with the Green AI view that efficiency should be an explicit objective alongside accuracy ( Schwartz et al., 2020 ) . Wide deployment also depends on generalisation beyond the pre-training data. Here, the pre-training corpus is a further contribution of this work. To our knowledge, it is one of the largest and most diverse collections of cell-centred crops assembled to date.
blocks.zh: C-LiTE在大约16分钟内就将一百万个细胞嵌入了单个A100 GPU上(分节5.4),而CytoFormer则大约嵌入了5.6小时. 必须指出,绝对时间取决于硬件、批量规模和执行。 相对差异反映了计算成本方面的差距,应当在不同设置之间保持。 C-LiTE可以用通用嵌入法来代表每个被检测到的细胞,能够进行无标签的回旋,形态特征分析和空间分析. 以这种方式减少推论费用也符合Green AI的观点,即效率应与准确性并列是一个明确的目标(Schwartz等,2020年)。 广泛部署还取决于培训前数据以外的通用性。 在这方面,培训前手册是这项工作的又一贡献。 据我们所知,它是迄今为止聚集的以细胞为中心的作物中规模最大、种类最多的集合之一。

blocks.en: We release the corpus and models so that this can be tested directly. These findings should be read in light of several limitations, each of which points to future work. First, all models were evaluated by linear probing. Performance under fine-tuning, or within detection and segmentation pipelines, remains to be tested. Second, pre-training used HoVer-Net detections at a single resolution of 0.5 mpp; therefore, robustness to detection noise and higher-resolution data was not assessed. Multi-resolution pre-training could address the latter. Third, the corpus was limited to TCGA H&E slides, and behaviour on other stains and on immunohistochemistry remains untested. Fourth, the pseudoinverse provides the minimum-norm least-squares solution, yielding a smaller spatial filter whose projection into the original spatial domain minimises the squared reconstruction error relative to the pretrained filter. This provides an approximate transfer of the pretrained spatial structure rather than guaranteeing an exact preservation of the original patch embeddings. Finally, the ablations did not vary the pre-training data. Beyond these limitations, adding molecular supervision to a lightweight backbone could combine the strengths of C-LiTE and CytoFormer at practical cost.
blocks.zh: 我们放出炸弹和模型 这样就可以直接测试了 这些结论应结合若干限制因素来理解,每一局限都指出了今后的工作。 首先,所有模型都是通过线性探测来评估的. 微调或探测和分解管道内的性能仍有待测试。 第二,预训使用HoVer-Net探测器,单分分辨率为0.5 mpp;因此,对探测噪音的强度和高分辨率数据没有进行评估。 多决议前培训可以解决后者。 第三,病历仅限于TCGA H&E幻灯片,其他污点和免疫史化学上的行为仍未经过检验。 第四,伪反向提供了最小的-Norm最小平方的溶液,产生一个更小的空间滤波器,其投射到原始空间域中,相对于预受训练的滤波器,最小化了平方重建出错. 这提供了预先训练的空间结构的近似转移,而不是保证精确地保存原始补丁嵌入. 最后,培训前数据没有变化。 除了这些限制之外,在轻量级骨干上增加分子监督可以以实际成本将C-LiTE和CytoFormer的优点结合起来.

blocks.en: Overall, this study shows that strong cellular representations do not require large models. Fine spatial granularity and diverse pre-training data were shown to be more important than parameter count. C-LiTE offers a practical and efficient foundation for cell-level analysis across whole slides and cohorts.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,本研究显示,强大的细胞表现不需要大型模型. 精细的空间颗粒性和多样化的培训前数据显示比参数数更重要。 C-LiTE为整个幻灯片和组群的细胞层分析提供了一个实用而高效的基础.

blocks.en: Code and Data availability
blocks.zh: 代码和数据可用性

blocks.en:
The source code for C-LiTE is publicly available at https://github.com/eshasadia/C-LiTE . An example notebook demonstrating its application has also been incorporated into TIA Toolbox ( https://github.com/tissueimageanalytics/tiatoolbox ). The pre-trained model weights are available through Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/eshasadia/C-LiTE .
The pre-training corpus was derived from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), with WSIs retrieved from the NCI Imaging Data Commons ( https://portal.imaging.datacommons.cancer.gov ). blocks.en: A.1 Benchmark composition
blocks.zh: A.1 基准组成

blocks.en: The seven benchmark datasets used for evaluation are summarised in Table A.1 . They cover mitosis classification, nucleus classification and immune-cell phenotyping, and include one non-H&E benchmark (MONKEY, PAS stain). Their class distributions are given in Table A.2 – Table A.8 . All benchmarks are imbalanced, and several contain classes that make up less than 2% of cells, including dead cells in PanNuke, eosinophils and neutrophils in CoNIC, and neutrophils, melanophage and plasma cells in PUMA. This imbalance motivated the use of macro-F1 and balanced accuracy as the primary metrics ( subsubsection 5.1.3 ). The mitosis benchmark was compiled from five public datasets to increase variation in tissue type, scanner and institution ( Table A.2 ). For NuCLS, we used the super-level taxonomy described in subsubsection 5.1.2 .
blocks.zh: 表A.1概述了用于评价的七个基准数据集。 它们包括线粒体硬化分类、核子分类和免疫细胞活化,包括一个非H&E基准(MONKEY,PAS污名)。 其等级分布见表A.2-表A.8。 所有的基准均不平衡,有几种包含的细胞组成比例还不到2%的分类,包括PanNuke的死细胞,CoNIC的异生细胞和中子细胞,以及PUMA的中子细胞,中子细胞和等离子细胞. 这种不平衡促使使用宏观-F1和平衡的准确性作为主要指标(分节5.1.3.)。 线粒体硬化基准是根据5个公共数据集汇编的,以增加组织类型、扫描仪和机构的差异(表A.2)。 对于NuCLS,我们使用了分节5.1.2所描述的超级分类学.

blocks.en: A.2 Pre-training configuration
blocks.zh: A.2 培训前配置

blocks.en: The pre-training configurations for all three C-LiTE variants are summarised in Table A.9 . All models were trained on 64 × 64 64\times 64 px cell crops at 0.5 mpp. With a patch size of 4 × 4 4\times 4 , each input was therefore represented by a 16 × 16 16\times 16 token grid. We used two global views per cell and omitted local crops, which are commonly employed in DINOv2. This choice reflects the nature of the input data: each crop already contains a single complete cell, such that further cropping would risk excluding part of the object of interest.
blocks.zh: 表A.9概述了所有三种C-LiTE变体的培训前配置。 所有型号都接受了64×64 64\times 64 px细胞作物0.5 mpp的培训. 由于补丁大小为4×4 4\times 4,因此每个输入都用16×16 16\times 16个令牌网格表示. 我们使用每个细胞的两种全球观点,省略了在DINOv2中常用的当地作物. 这一选择反映了输入数据的性质:每个作物已经包含一个单一的完整单元格,这样进一步的收成将有可能排除部分感兴趣的对象.

blocks.en: A.3 Distillation configuration

blocks.en: We initialised C-LiTE ∗ U {}_{U}^{*} and C-LiTE ∗ V {}_{V}^{*} using ViT-5-S student models distilled from UNI2 Chen et al. (2024a) and Virchow2 Zimmermann et al. (2024) , respectively, prior to self-supervised pre-training ( Table A.10 ). During distillation, the frozen teacher and student received the same augmented view of each cell, and the student was trained to reproduce the teacher’s embedding without supervision from class labels. As both teacher models require inputs of size 224 × 224 224\times 224 , cell crops were resized to this resolution exclusively during distillation. The linear projection used to align the teacher and student embedding dimensions was subsequently discarded.

blocks.en: A.4 Per-class evaluation
blocks.zh: A.4 按类别进行的评价

blocks.en: Per-class precision, recall, and F1 scores were derived from the same linear probes described in subsection 5.2 , with each class treated in turn as the positive class. The results are presented in Table A.11 – Table A.17 , following the order in which the benchmark datasets are introduced in the main text.
blocks.zh: 每等精度,回想,和F1分数都是从第5.2分节所描述的同一种线性探测器得到的,每等分被依次视为正分. 表A.11-表A.17按正文中采用基准数据集的顺序列出结果。

blocks.en: Two consistent patterns emerge across the benchmarks. First, performance is generally strong and relatively consistent across models for the most prevalent classes, whereas inter-model differences are more pronounced for the less frequent classes identified in subsection A.1 . For instance, on MIDOG, the F1 score for normal mitoses varies by only 0.02 across models, compared with a variation of 0.16 for atypical mitoses. Second, classification errors for the rarest immune cell populations are primarily characterised by low recall. In Immunocto, recall for CD8 + T cells and macrophages remains below 0.18 and 0.35, respectively, while precision is substantially higher. This disparity between precision and recall suggests that these populations are predominantly under-detected, with relatively few false-positive predictions, rather than frequently misclassified as other cell types.
blocks.zh: 各种基准出现了两种一致的模式。 首先,对于最流行的类别来说,各模型的性能一般都很强并相对一致,而对于A.1分节所查明的不太频繁的类别来说,模型间的差异则更为明显。 例如,在MIDOG上,普通相模的F1分差只有0.02分,而非典型相模的分差为0.16分. 第二,最罕见的免疫细胞群的分类错误主要以低召回为特征. 在Immunocto中,CD8 + T细胞和宏phages的召回率分别低于0.18和0.35,而精度则要高得多. 这种精确度和召回度的差异表明,这些人群主要被检测不足,虚假阳性预测相对较少,而不是经常被误归类为其他类型的细胞.
